name: API Ninjas Exercises
tagline: Search 3,000+ exercises by muscle, type, and difficulty
description: The API Ninjas Exercises API provides a searchable database of over 3,000 workout exercises targeting every major muscle group. Query by name, exercise type, muscle, difficulty, and equipment. Returns structured exercise data including instructions. Note: commercial use and possibly full access require a premium subscription — the free tier is limited.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header; self-serve signup at api-ninjas.com/register

pricing.free_tier_limits: 3,000 API calls/month platform-wide; Exercises API commercial use not permitted on free tier (premium required for commercial)
pricing.paid_plans: Developer $39–59/mo (100k calls), Business $99–149/mo (1M), Professional $199–299/mo (10M), Enterprise custom

rate_limits: Monthly quotas by plan (Free 3,000; Developer 100,000; Business 1,000,000; Professional 10,000,000). Requests denied after quota; no published per-second rate limit.

example.response_snippet: [{"name": "incline hammer curls", "type": "strength", "muscle": "biceps", "equipment": "dumbbell", "difficulty": "beginner", "instructions": "Seat yourself on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand..."}]

use_cases: search exercises by target muscle group
filter workout moves by difficulty level
list exercises by type (cardio, strength, stretching)
look up exercise instructions by name
